mission: Leap 7: Test-Driven Autonomy - Two-Stage TDD Protocol

tasks.title: Define Two-Stage TDD Workflow Specification
tasks.description: Create formal specification for Intent-to-Spec → Spec-to-Execution TDD workflow. Define input modes (auto-selection, natural language intent, explicit spec), approval gates, test-first generation logic, and verification checkpoints. Use spec-kit methodology with Goals, Personas, Success Criteria sections.
acceptance_criteria: Workflow supports 3 input modes: auto-selection from backlog, natural language intent, explicit spec file
Spec approval checkpoint defined with human review prompt and edit loop
TDD graph generation logic: Test tasks created before Code tasks with verification_target
Test verification gate defined with 100% pass requirement and Article I retry logic
PR creation workflow specified with git worktree isolation and mergeability check

tasks.title: Design NECESSARY Compliance Validator
tasks.description: Design AST-based validation system for NECESSARY pattern compliance in generated tests. Specify checks for descriptive names (no test_1), AAA structure (Arrange-Act-Assert), docstrings, and edge case coverage. Define auto-fix strategies for common violations.
acceptance_criteria: AST parsing logic defined for Python pytest files
Validation rules: descriptive names (regex ^test_[a-z_]+_when_[a-z_]+_then_[a-z_]+$), AAA comments, docstrings
Auto-fix strategies: name suggestion, AAA template insertion, docstring generation
Integration with test_generator agent output validation
Confidence-scored fix recommendations (0.6+ threshold)

tasks.title: Architect Test Verification Gate
tasks.description: Design test verification checkpoint that runs full test suite after Code task completion. Specify retry logic (2x, 3x, 10x timeout), failure handling (rollback vs. fix), and integration with TodoWrite progress tracking. Define test isolation strategy (pytest-xdist, memory-aware workers).
acceptance_criteria: 100% test pass requirement (no exceptions per Article II)
Article I retry logic: 2x, 3x, up to 10x timeout on incomplete results
Memory-aware worker calculation (3 workers local model, 10 cloud-only)
Rollback strategy: git restore on test failure
Integration with memory_aware_test_runner.py (merged in PR #56)

tasks.title: Design PR Creation and Mergeability Workflow
tasks.description: Specify git worktree isolation workflow for PR creation. Define branch naming conventions, commit message templates (with Co-Authored-By: Claude), PR body format (Summary, Test Plan, Constitutional Compliance), and mergeability checks (CI green, no conflicts, branch protection satisfied).
acceptance_criteria: Git worktree creation pattern: git worktree add ../Agency-{session_id} -b leap-7-tdd-autonomy
Commit message template: imperative title + body with Claude Co-Author
PR body format: ## Summary, ## Test Plan (checklist), ## Constitutional Compliance (Articles I-V)
Mergeability checks: gh pr checks, git status (no conflicts), CI pipeline status
Auto-cleanup: git worktree remove after merge

tasks.title: Architect TDD-First Task Graph Generator
tasks.description: Design TaskGraph generation logic that creates Test tasks BEFORE Code tasks. Specify dependency inference (Test depends on Code, Code depends on Spec), tier classification (P1/P2/P3 based on complexity), and verification_target auto-population. Define VectorStore query for similar past graphs.
acceptance_criteria: Test task generation: verification_target = code_task_id, dependencies = [code_task_id]
Dependency inference: Spec → Code → Test (reversed order in graph generation)
Tier classification: architecture/ADR = Tier 1, implementation/testing = Tier 2
VectorStore query: search for similar graphs (confidence ≥ 0.6) before generation
Pydantic validation: all Code tasks have Test dependencies (Article II enforcement)

acceptance_criteria: AAA structure (Arrange-Act-Assert) with comments

100% test coverage for IntentParser class
NECESSARY compliant (descriptive names, docstrings)
